#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

struct Pair {
    long long first;
    long long second;
    static Pair makePair(long long f, long long s) {
        return {f, s};
    }
};

class Graph {
public:
    static const int REMOVED_BIT = 0;

    int vertexCount;
    int edgeCount;
    vector<int> firstOutbound, firstInbound, nextOutbound, nextInbound, from, to;
    vector<long long> weight, capacity;
    vector<int> reverseEdge, flags;
    vector<vector<int>> edges;

    Graph(int vCount, int eCapacity = 0) {
        vertexCount = vCount;
        firstOutbound.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        if (eCapacity > 0) {
            from.reserve(eCapacity);
            to.reserve(eCapacity);
            nextOutbound.reserve(eCapacity);
            nextInbound.reserve(eCapacity);
            weight.reserve(eCapacity);
            capacity.reserve(eCapacity);
            reverseEdge.reserve(eCapacity);
            flags.reserve(eCapacity);
            edges.reserve(eCapacity);
        }
        edgeCount = 0;
    }

    int addEdge(int fromID, int toID, long long w, long long cap, int revEdge = -1) {
        ensureEdgeCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        if (firstOutbound[fromID] != -1) {
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = firstOutbound[fromID];
        } else {
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = -1;
        }
        firstOutbound[fromID] = edgeCount;

        if (firstInbound.size() > 0) {
            if (firstInbound[toID] != -1) {
                nextInbound[edgeCount] = firstInbound[toID];
            } else {
                nextInbound[edgeCount] = -1;
            }
            firstInbound[toID] = edgeCount;
        }

        from.push_back(fromID);
        to.push_back(toID);

        if (capacity.size() <= edgeCount) {
            capacity.resize(edgeCount + 1);
        }
        if (weight.size() <= edgeCount) {
            weight.resize(edgeCount + 1);
        }
        if (reverseEdge.size() <= edgeCount) {
            reverseEdge.resize(edgeCount + 1);
        }
        if (flags.size() <= edgeCount) {
            flags.resize(edgeCount + 1);
        }

        capacity[edgeCount] = cap;
        weight[edgeCount] = w;
        reverseEdge[edgeCount] = revEdge;
        edges.push_back(vector<int>());
        return edgeCount++;
    }

    int addFlowWeightedEdge(int u, int v, long long w, long long cap) {
        if (cap == 0) {
            return addEdge(u, v, w, 0);
        } else {
            int lastEdgeId = addEdge(u, v, w, cap);
            int rev = addEdge(v, u, -w, 0);
            reverseEdge[lastEdgeId] = rev;
            reverseEdge[rev] = lastEdgeId;
            return lastEdgeId;
        }
    }

private:
    void ensureEdgeCapacity(int size) {
        // No explicit resizing needed due to vector usage
    }
};

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    Graph& g;
    int s, t;
    vector<long long> phi;
    vector<long long> dijkstraResult;
    vector<int> lastEdge;
    vector<int> visited;
    int visitIdx;

    MinCostFlow(Graph& graph, int source, int dest, bool hasNegativeEdges) 
        : g(graph), s(source), t(dest) {
        int n = g.vertexCount;
        phi.assign(n, LLONG_MAX);
        if (hasNegativeEdges) {
            fordBellman();
        }
        dijkstraResult.assign(n, LLONG_MAX);
        lastEdge.assign(n, -1);
        if (g.firstOutbound.size() > 0) {
            visited.assign(n, 0);
        }
        visitIdx = 0;
    }

    static Pair minCostMaxFlow(Graph& graph, int source, int dest, bool hasNegativeEdges, long long maxFlow) {
        return MinCostFlow(graph, source, dest, hasNegativeEdges).minCostMaxFlow(maxFlow);
    }

    Pair minCostMaxFlow(long long maxFlow) {
        long long totalCost = 0, totalFlow = 0;

        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            if (g.firstOutbound.size() > 0) {
                dijkstraAlgorithm();
            } else {
                dijkstraAlgorithmFull();
            }
            if (lastEdge[t] == -1) {
                return Pair::makePair(totalCost, totalFlow);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < (int)dijkstraResult.size(); ++i) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != LLONG_MAX) {
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
                }
            }

            long long incrementFlow = maxFlow;
            long long currentCost = 0;
            int v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                int e = lastEdge[v];
                incrementFlow = min(incrementFlow, (long long)g.capacity[e]);
                currentCost += g.weight[e];
                v = g.from[e];
            }

            maxFlow -= incrementFlow;
            totalCost += currentCost * incrementFlow;
            totalFlow += incrementFlow;

            v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                int e = lastEdge[v];
                g.capacity[e] -= incrementFlow;
                g.capacity[g.reverseEdge[e]] += incrementFlow;
                v = g.from[e];
            }
        }

        return Pair::makePair(totalCost, totalFlow);
    }

private:
    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[s] = 0;
        vector<bool> inQueue(phi.size(), false);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        inQueue[s] = true;

        int maxSteps = 2 * (int)phi.size() * (int)phi.size();
        int stepCount = 0;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            inQueue[u] = false;

            for (int e = g.firstOutbound[u]; e != -1; e = g.nextOutbound[e]) {
                if (g.capacity[e] != 0) {
                    long long ndist = phi[u] + g.weight[e];
                    int v = g.to[e];
                    if (phi[v] > ndist) {
                        phi[v] = ndist;
                        if (!inQueue[v]) {
                            q.push(v);
                            inQueue[v] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (++stepCount > maxSteps) {
                throw invalid_argument("Graph contains negative cycle");
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[s] = 0;
        // Priority queue of pairs (cost, node)
        priority_queue<pair<long long, int>, vector<pair<long long, int>>, greater<pair<long long, int>>> pq;
        pq.push({0, s});

        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [dist, u] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();

            if (dist > dijkstraResult[u])
                continue;

            for (int e = g.firstOutbound[u]; e != -1; e = g.nextOutbound[e]) {
                if (g.capacity[e] != 0) {
                    int v = g.to[e];
                    long long ndist = dist + g.weight[e] - phi[v] + phi[u];
                    if (dijkstraResult[v] > ndist) {
                        dijkstraResult[v] = ndist;
                        lastEdge[v] = e;
                        pq.push({ndist, v});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull() {
        ++visitIdx;
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[s] = 0;

        for (int count = 0; count < (int)dijkstraResult.size(); ++count) {
            int u = -1;
            long long minDist = LLONG_MAX;

            for (int i = 0; i < (int)dijkstraResult.size(); ++i) {
                if (visited[i] != visitIdx && dijkstraResult[i] < minDist) {
                    minDist = dijkstraResult[i];
                    u = i;
                }
            }

            if (u == -1)
                break;

            visited[u] = visitIdx;

            for (int e = g.firstOutbound[u]; e != -1; e = g.nextOutbound[e]) {
                if (g.capacity[e] != 0) {
                    int v = g.to[e];
                    long long total = g.weight[e] - phi[v] + phi[u] + dijkstraResult[u];
                    if (dijkstraResult[v] > total) {
                        dijkstraResult[v] = total;
                        lastEdge[v] = e;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string sStr;
    cin >> sStr;
    vector<char> s(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) s[i] = sStr[i];

    vector<int> ugliness(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int val;
        cin >> val;
        ugliness[i] = -val;
    }

    int size = 1 + 26 + n / 2 + 1;
    Graph graph(size);
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
            int cost = INT_MAX;
            if (c == s[i]) {
                cost = min(cost, ugliness[i]);
            }
            if (c == s[n - 1 - i]) {
                cost = min(cost, ugliness[n - 1 - i]);
            }
            graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(1 + (c - 'a'), 1 + 26 + i, cost, 1);
        }
    }

    vector<int> occurs(128, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        ++occurs[s[i]];

    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
        int index = 1 + (c - 'a');
        graph.addEdge(0, index, 0, occurs[c]);
    }

    int sink = 1 + 26 + n / 2;
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
        graph.addEdge(1 + 26 + i, sink, 0, 2);
    }

    auto flow = MinCostFlow::minCostMaxFlow(graph, 0, sink, false, n);
    cout << -flow.first << "\n";

    return 0;
}
